creatives.title: Find and message your next customers automatically
creatives.body:
If you are still going on LinkedIn, manually searching for potential customers, and writing every message one by one, stop wasting your time. 

With Origami, you just enter your website URL. It identifies the right people to contact, researches them, and writes relevant outreach for you across LinkedIn and email. 

You stay focused on building your product and talking to customers while Origami handles the repetitive work required to reach them.

Try it for free at origami.chat
creatives.transcript: If you're still going through LinkedIn and finding customers and writing them messages by hand, stop. This tool is going to make your life 20 times easier. You go to origami.chat, you hit start for free and then you paste your website's URL. After that, it gives you a list of customers that you'd already be prospecting on LinkedIn, but it does it in 5 minutes. Once the list of customers look good, you can come over and have the agent help you write messaging. Then, the agent will create messaging for you. All you have to do is check over the messaging and make sure you have a strong offer. After everything looks good, you simply hit launch campaign. Then you wait for the replies to come in. All you need to do is give it your website's URL and it'll set up the entire outbound system for you.

creatives.pain: Manually searching LinkedIn and writing messages one by one wastes time.
creatives.promise: A customer list in 5 minutes and outbound set up from just your URL.
creatives.mechanism: Paste your site URL; agent builds a prospect list, writes messaging, you approve and launch LinkedIn and email campaign.

We turned a closer into a list builder. So I gave the prospecting to Katie. She spots the signals, does the research, reaches out on email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and the meetings show up on his calendar. He didn't write a single email for those. When Alta does the prospecting, your closers close, and nobody's paying 300k a year for subject lines. Let agents prospect, let humans close.

creatives.title: Book a demo - see Clay's account scoring model live
creatives.body:
Fit scoring tells you who looks right. Engagement scoring tells you who's ready. Most teams never combine them.

Book a demo - we'll walk through how we combine enrichment-based fit scoring with first-party engagement data to surface the accounts worth working.
creatives.transcript: Our sales team went from 0 to 11 reps in a matter of months. And our very first problem was a brutal one because out of millions of companies, which thousand actually deserved our team's time. You can't answer that on gut feel alone as your team grows. So, we score every account two ways and then combine them. First, an account fit score from enrichment data, like company size and tech stack, which shows who looks like our best customers. Then, an engagement score from our own first-party data, showing who's opening emails, sitting in a live deal, or already talking to sales. Want to see which accounts actually deserve your team's time? Book a demo, and we'll show you how to build your tier 1 account list in Clay.

numbers: millions of companies to a few thousand

creatives.promise: Surface the accounts worth working by combining fit and engagement scores.
creatives.mechanism: Enrichment-based fit score (size, tech stack) combined with first-party engagement data to build a Tier 1 list.

creatives.title: We Increased NPS 38% with Voice AI
creatives.body:
We had Medical Assistants spending hours every day playing phone tag instead of caring for patients.

Mike Tadlock, COO at Pine Park Health, knew they had a problem. As they scaled to 200 senior living communities, their team was drowning in phone calls, reminders, scheduling, routine follow-ups.

So they tried something bold: AI voice agents named Ava and Jay to handle the calls.

The result? 38% increase in patient satisfaction. 55.7% of outbound calls successfully booked. And 2.1 full-time employees worth of time freed up for actual patient care.

Watch Mike explain how they did it, and why their senior patients actually loved it.

https://www.retellai.com
creatives.transcript: We've seen a really significant business impact after launching Ava and Jay in partnership with Retail. First and foremost, around NPS, our satisfaction scores. We've seen a 38% rise, specifically when we ask about scheduling and how it's going. The second big impact is around successfully filling up that underutilized PCP schedule capacity. Jay successfully books visits about 55.7% of the time when he connects with one of our outbound scheduling efforts. The third big impact that we've had, we've recouped 2.1 FTE of medical assistant time that we've been able to deploy back to much more complex, much more meaningful patient interactions.
